question:
**Direction: The sentence given below has one misspelt word. Spot the INCORRECTLY spelt word and select its correct spelling.**

She needs to visit a phyziotherapist.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Physiotherapist**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The incorrectly spelt word is &
